clean_description: The Story of a New Name follows the evolving friendship between Lila and Elena, two women from post-WWII Naples, Italy. As Lila navigates the challenges of marriage and family business, Elena pursues her education and seeks a life beyond their neighborhood. Their complex bond serves as both a source of strength and a reflection of their individual struggles with love, jealousy, and personal freedom.
themes: friendship, identity, love, jealousy, personal growth
